messages:
Maria G: hey y'all — dropping the latest Figma for the evals prompt-sets flow. main changes: inline comment panel inside the regression diff, compact diff mode, and a confirmation modal for approvals. need quick copy/accessibility/ux nits before we lock for the sprint. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/evals-approval-flow Josh K: skimmed it — looks solid. one thing: the primary CTA in the modal is just 'Approve' which feels ambiguous. are we approving the prompts, or also starting rollout? that could be risky. Sam L: accessibility quick note: the red 'Reject' CTA currently has a contrast ratio around 3.6 on the blue background — fails WCAG AA for normal text. also keyboard focus lands on the background when you open the diff modal (tab trap). Aleks P: +1 on the approve ambiguity. also bulk actions: the current mock auto-selects all items when you open bulk actions — that's surprising. I'd expect persistent selections or explicit select-all. Maria G: good catches. proposed copy tweak for the modal body: "Are you sure you want to mark these prompt sets as approved? This will mark them as approved and make them available for rollout actions." keeps 'rollout' separate. Jamie T: I think we should separate marking as approved from starting a rollout. Suggested CTAs: primary "Mark as approved" (green), secondary "Start rollout" (neutral) on the next screen. reduces accidental rollouts. DesignBot: automated accessibility scan results for this prototype: - .btn-danger contrast ratio: 3.6 (threshold 4.5) — ACTION: increase color contrast or use bold large text. - diff-viewer: missing aria-live on summary changes. - diff-modal: tabindex order includes elements behind the modal on open (tabindex traps). Details: https://ci.designbot/reports/1863009123 Sam L: small snippet to add live region for diff summary (aria): ```
3 regressions — 2 critical
``` Also ensure modal focus is set programmatically: `modal.focus()` on open and restore focus on close. Josh K: UX nit for the diff itself: inline-only highlights are confusing for multi-line prompts. prefer side-by-side collapsed by default with an expand toggle for inline inline view. show whitespace diffs clearly. Aleks P: add a small numeric badge next to the scorecard header showing failing count. default filter should be "Only failing tests" when you land on a regression view so product teams see issues first. Maria G: actionable items then: - change modal copy to "Mark as approved" and hide "Start rollout" to next step — owner: Jamie T — due: EOD Wed - update .btn-danger color and re-run DesignBot scan — owner: Sam L — due: tomorrow - add aria-live to diff summary and fix modal focus trap — owner: Sam L — due: tomorrow - change bulk-selection default and add explicit select-all checkbox — owner: Aleks P — due: Fri - side-by-side diff as default for multiline prompts + small compact toggle for inline — owner: Josh K — spike: 2d - add failing-count badge + default filter "Only failing" — owner: Maria G — due: Thu Jamie T: acked — I'll take the rollout separation work and wire in the two-step flow. :thumbsup: Maria G: perfect. can we reconvene Friday demo after the fixes? if DesignBot still reports contrast/tab issues, block merging. DesignBot: new quick note: when you update color tokens, include token names in PR (e.g., --color-danger-700) so themes pick it up. Josh K: tiny copy tweak: change the per-test CTA "Approve change" -> "Mark test as approved" (makes the action explicit). also consider a hover affordance that shows "approves this test only" for clarity. Aleks P: one last accessibility nit — make sure the regression badge has an accessible name: `aria-label="3 failing tests"` so screen readers announce the count. Maria G: thanks team. I'll update the ticket with the action items and owners. Friday demo noted. :sparkles:
